printed: Haematology Blood groups Blood groups (A, B, O, Le, Fy, Rh etc.) are set in roman, as are the antigens after which the groups are named. The genes corresponding to the antigens are usually denoted by italic letters (e.g. A). Issit PD, Crookston MC. Blood group terminology: current conventions. Trans-fusion, 1984, 24:2-7.
